candidate.title: What Is Agentic RAG?
candidate.description:
In this video we will be discuss the basic differences between trditional RAG vs agentic rag
Agentic RAG combines the structured information retrieval and generation of traditional Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with the autonomous decision-making capabilities of AI agents. This approach allows systems to dynamically adapt their workflows, integrate tools, and handle complex tasks, ultimately improving the accuracy, adaptability, and efficiency of information retrieval and response generation.
